lcra.name: Lower Colorado River Authority
lcra.note: LCRA posts its own lake levels on its Hydromet site. The Highland Lakes levels on this site come from the Texas Water Development Board's daily data, which takes them from LCRA.

city-of-corpus-christi.name: City of Corpus Christi
city-of-corpus-christi.note: Lake levels for the water-supply system come from TWDB.

grda.name: Grand River Dam Authority
grda.note: Grand Lake's level is read from the USACE Tulsa District CWMS series PENS (Pensacola Dam).

alabama-power.name: Alabama Power
alabama-power.note: Its lake levels are read from USACE Mobile District CWMS series marked APCO.
